title: Bashar :: 2026 The Year of Disclosure - Highlights
author: Bashar Channeled by Darryl Anka
opening_summary: Bashar introduces 2026 as 'the year of disclosure,' signifying increased public information about extraterrestrial life, UFOs, and UAPs. Disclosure extends beyond ET contact to reveal hidden secrets with significant consequences. The session addresses misconceptions about extraterrestrial intentions, emphasizing that 99% of ETs interacting with Earth are positively oriented. Bashar clarifies that while some negative-oriented species exist, they remain isolated and managed by positive civilizations. The vast majority of humanity's contact involves benevolent beings.

qa_topics.question: Why do some people perceive ETs as good while others see them as negative or destructive?
qa_topics.answer_gist: Perception depends on ET orientation and human fear responses. 99% of ETs engaging Earth are positive; negative ones are rare and managed. Reptilians trigger mammalian fight-or-flight responses due to species differences, not necessarily hostile intent.

qa_topics.question: Will disclosure require both positive and negative ET perspectives for open contact?
qa_topics.answer_gist: No separation needed. Positive ETs (99%) handle Earth contact while protecting humanity from the small negative fraction. Duality exists but doesn't require human exposure to harmful beings.

qa_topics.question: Are reptilians inherently dangerous to humans?
qa_topics.answer_gist: Most reptilians are neutral or positive; few dislike humans due to mammalian fear responses. Humans unconsciously assume reptiles want to consume them, escalating perceived hostility.

quotes.quote: The vast majority, 99% of extraterrestrials interacting with your planet are positively oriented.
You have to be able to have the discernment to tell the difference between your own negative vibrations and fear-based beliefs and what is actually coming from an extraterrestrial.
2026, the year of disclosure—more information coming out about ETs, UFOs, ships, UAPs.
It might be your own fear-based energies that you're feeling and have nothing to do with extraterrestrial intentions.
Those engaged with your planet are 99% positive and keeping the small percentage that are not positive away from you.

predictions_and_dates.context: Designated as 'the year of disclosure' with increased ET/UFO information release
